title: Default pause on remote UNKNOWN failures
description: When request reached provider but error remains UNKNOWN, classify as protectable UNKNOWN to prevent infinite spend.
acceptance_criteria: Remote UNKNOWN (has status/response or OpenAI/Gemini API wrapper) yields code=UNKNOWN_FAILURE with shouldProtect=true; local UNKNOWN remains shouldProtect=false.
review_initial_requirements: Remote detection heuristics must be strict; AbortError and pure local errors must not trigger protection.
review_regression_requirements: Run classification tests; verify unknown_remote case protects while socket reset local case does not.

title: Ensure pause is applied before releasing scheduler capacity (request mode)
description: Await protection event-queue update in request-mode protectable failures so pausedUntil is visible immediately to the scheduler.
acceptance_criteria: On protectable failure, endpoint update is committed before additional scheduling; repeated immediate requests against a paused endpoint do not occur under concurrency.
review_initial_requirements: Avoid deadlocks in the event queue; keep error path responsive; ensure batch mode unchanged.
review_regression_requirements: Manual run with 1 endpoint + concurrency>1: after rate limit, requests stop until pause expires; no UI freeze.
